titulo: The bag inside, the door shut
caption:
The bag inside, the door shut

The bag was waiting on the doorstep. One hop inside, the door shut, and the hallway never felt the cold.

A bag brought in right away takes ten seconds, and the door is open for only two of them.

For whoever brings it in right away and shuts the door.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A hallway with a closed cream door on the right. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the door swings open onto warm light and a brown paper grocery bag with an orange sticking out of it standing on the step. The bag hops in an arc onto the hall floor and the door swings shut behind it with a small sparkle above. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, bringing it in and shutting the door.
